scope: Explicit native collection vocabulary over real SQLite/BSON transactions; not a Mongo-compatible client or canonical API integration. Mongo remains unchanged; SQLite is not selected for users.

corepack pnpm --dir remix exec tsc --noEmit --pretty false

semantics.identity: Distinct nonempty string and ObjectId identities; deterministic identity-key ordering, not Mongo sort order.
semantics.filter: Validated explicit eq/order/exists/contains/and/or AST; missing is distinct from null; equality is BSON-type-exact including numeric type. Ordering has no coercion or collation.
semantics.update: Set, unset and checked existing integer increment; immutable _id; conflicting paths refused; no upsert/options/expression pipelines.
semantics.unique: Immutable persisted single-field definitions; sparse skips missing only; non-sparse missing maps to null; multikey expands one scalar array level with within-document deduplication.
semantics.transactions: Actual SQLite transaction, scoped synchronous operations, caught validation/write errors poison commit, cross-collection rollback and serialized two-handle conditional mutation.
semantics.cost: Correctness-first complete scans; 128-row processing batch is not a truncation limit. Every find/mutation scans O(n) records; this is not production index performance.

remainingRequirements: No canonical API/provider selection or registration/session acceptance using SQLite.
Canonical Mongo filters/update expressions, projection/sort/cursor contracts, TTL, compound/partial indexes, aggregate/search and migration readiness remain unsupported.
ACL, logical-byte accounting, private Thing history, session/home-vs-active authority and secure profile bootstrap still require canonical adapter integration.

First native adapter consumer should implement the owner/revision-bound userStorage ledger repository using this transaction vocabulary and existing canonical validators, alongside the unchanged Mongo implementation; content, ledger and history must share one actual transaction.
Real API register/session/private Thing CRUD, competing-owner refusal, accounting/history rollback and cold-restart acceptance remain required.
